messages.website.knowledge.centipedeFallback: Evil Centipede and Dark Centipede: a wild kill that drops no equipment awards one random basic weapon or necklace (the ordinary boss can also award armour), with equal chances for all three classes. Fallback gear can roll exceptional stats and affixes. Advanced weapons, Gale gear and special rings are excluded from this fallback. Trials, challenges and summoned monsters are excluded.
